episodes.title: I'm Luffy! The Man Who Will Become the Pirate King!
episodes.summary: A band of pirates led by Alvida plundered a ship, only to find a barrel which contains a strange boy named Luffy. Luffy is on a quest to find the legendary treasure "One Piece" and he befriends the ship's cabin-boy, Koby, who actually wants to become a marine officer. Luffy defeats Alvida and the two journey on in search of crewmates.

episodes.title: The Great Swordsman Appears! Pirate Hunter Roronoa Zoro
episodes.summary: Luffy and Koby arrive at Shell Island, a Marine base. They meet the bounty hunter Roronoa Zoro, held under arrest by the infamous marine, Captain Morgan, and his son Helmeppo.

episodes.title: Morgan versus Luffy! Who's the Mysterious Pretty Girl?
episodes.summary: Luffy convinces Zoro to join his crew, but they must first defeat Captain Morgan. After freeing the island from Morgan's oppressive rule, Koby is accepted as a marine while the other two continue on their journey.

episodes.title: Luffy's Past! The Red-Haired Shanks Appears!
episodes.summary: Out on the sea, Luffy almost loses his hat and reflects on his past, and how a pirate named Shanks influenced him. Afterwards, Luffy meets Nami, and Buggy the Clown's men.

episodes.title: A Terrifying Mysterious Power! Captain Buggy, the Clown Pirate!
episodes.summary: In order to save herself and steal a map to the Grand Line, Nami tricks Luffy into allowing her to turn him over to Buggy.

episodes.title: Desperate Situation! Beast Tamer Mohji vs. Luffy!
episodes.summary: Mohji and Richie show up for revenge after Buggy's humiliating defeat in the previous episode, and Luffy meets a small dog guarding his master's store, even though he knows that he is long dead.

episodes.title: Epic Showdown! Swordsman Zoro vs. Acrobat Cabaji!
episodes.summary: Enraged by the actions of Buggy's crew, the city's mayor rushes to fight Buggy himself, but the Straw Hat Pirates come to his rescue. Zoro fights Cabaji, despite still being wounded from his previous encounter with Buggy, while Luffy faces the clown pirate himself and Nami searches for the map to the Grand Line.

episodes.title: Who is the Victor? Devil Fruit Power Showdown!
episodes.summary: Buggy's link to Shanks is revealed, and when he rips the straw hat Shanks gave Luffy, his rage knows no bounds. Who will win in this clash between Devil Fruit users?

episodes.title: The Honorable Liar? Captain Usopp!
episodes.summary: With Nami forming an alliance with the crew as their navigator (though not as an actual member), the crew arrives at the Syrup Village in search of a proper ship, where they meet the town liar, Usopp, who too has ties to Shanks.

episodes.title: The Weirdest Guy Ever! Jango the Hypnotist!
episodes.summary: When trying to convince his rich friend, Kaya, to give the Straw Hats a ship, Usopp is told to stay away from her by her caretaker, Klahadore. However, when Usopp and Luffy later see him conversing with a strange man, they learn of a plot to kill Kaya.

episodes.title: Expose the Plot! Pirate Butler, Captain Kuro!
episodes.summary: After learning of Captain Kuro's evil plan, Usopp runs back to the village to warn Kaya, only to find that after all his years of lying no one believes him.

episodes.title: Clash with the Black Cat Pirates! The Great Battle on the Slope!
episodes.summary: Usopp resolves to keep his story of pirates attacking the town a lie by making sure none reach it. Luffy, Zoro, Nami, and Usopp then try to keep the Black Cat Pirates at bay.

episodes.title: The Terrifying Duo! Meowban Brothers vs. Zoro!
episodes.summary: The Straw Hats manage to take out most of the opposing Black Cat Pirates, so Jango orders the Nyaban Brothers to attack. Meanwhile, after getting hypnotized by Jango, Luffy gets himself stuck under the collapsed mast of the Black Cat Pirates' ship.

episodes.title: Luffy Back in Action! Miss Kaya's Desperate Resistance!
episodes.summary: Captain Kuro himself arrives at the scene, and with Zoro too injured to fight, Luffy being incapacitated, and the other two being too weak to handle him, things seem hopeless. However, Kaya herself appears to bargain with Kuro.

episodes.title: Beat Kuro! Usopp the Man's Tearful Resolve!
episodes.summary: Zoro and Buchi (of the Nyaban Brothers) face off once again as Luffy and Kuro begin their fight. Usopp orders the Usopp Pirates to run away with Kaya, but Jango goes after them. A flashback reveals how Captain Kuro faked his death with Captain Morgan and how he became Kaya's butler.

episodes.title: Protect Kaya! The Usopp Pirates' Great Efforts!
episodes.summary: As the fight between Luffy and Kuro is close to an end, the Usopp Pirates do their best to avoid Jango.

episodes.title: Anger Explosion! Kuro vs. Luffy! How it Ends!
episodes.summary: Kuro's ultimate attack, "Shakushi", attacks everything in the area, whether friend or foe, and Luffy becomes enraged by his lack of regard for his crew. Will Luffy's determination overcome Kuro's sheer speed?

episodes.title: You're the Weird Creature! Gaimon and His Strange Friends!
episodes.summary: With Usopp now in the crew and a new ship, the Going Merry, under their command, the Straw Hats head to an island said to hold a fabled treasure, only to encounter a strange man stuck in a treasure box that has also been looking for this treasure.

episodes.title: The Three-Sword Style's Past! Zoro and Kuina's Vow!
episodes.summary: While Usopp & Luffy fool around with the ship's cannon one day, Zoro dreams about his childhood and the promise he made to Kuina.

episodes.title: Famous Cook! Sanji of the Sea Restaurant!
episodes.summary: The crew meets Johnny and Yosaku, Zoro's former companions, and they set sail for the Baratie restaurant in search of a cook.

episodes.title: Unwelcome Customer! Sanji's Food and Ghin's Debt!
episodes.summary: Sanji, a cook at the Baratie, helps a starving pirate named Gin. Luffy begins his job as a waiter to pay for the damage he did to the Baratie, and tries to convince Sanji to join his crew.

episodes.title: The Strongest Pirate Fleet! Commodore Don Krieg!
episodes.summary: Gin returns to the Baratie with his also-starving captain, Don Krieg, to whom Sanji once more gives food, but Don Krieg betrays the cook once he regains his energy.

episodes.title: Protect Baratie! The Great Pirate, Red Foot Zeff!
episodes.summary: It is revealed that Chef Zeff was a great pirate known as Red Leg Zeff. Gin explains the catastrophe the fleet met in Grand Line when they encountered Hawk-Eyes Mihawk, and Krieg attempts to take control of the Baratie.

episodes.title: Hawk-Eye Mihawk! The Great Swordsman Zoro Falls At Sea!
episodes.summary: As Nami steals the Going Merry, Mihawk has returned to finish the job, but Zoro challenges him to a duel in order to achieve his dream.

episodes.title: The Deadly Foot Technique Bursts Forth! Sanji vs. The Invincible Pearl!
episodes.summary: Mihawk leaves after defeating Zoro, so Krieg continues his invasion and has Pearl, one of his stronger crewmates, attack, and Sanji reveals his fighting skills. Meanwhile Johnny and Yosaku leave with Usopp and the wounded Zoro to go after Nami.

episodes.title: Zeff and Sanji's Dream! The Illusory All Blue!
episodes.summary: With Zeff held captive by Gin, Sanji has no choice but to take Pearl's hits, and he reflects on why Zeff means so much to him.

episodes.title: The Coldhearted Devil-man. Gin, the Pirate Fleet Battle Commander
episodes.summary: Gin finishes off Pearl, claiming that he wants to kill Sanji himself. Still wounded, Sanji faces Gin while Luffy attacks Don Krieg.

episodes.title: I Won't Die! Conclusion: Luffy vs. Krieg
episodes.summary: When Gin refuses to kill Sanji, Krieg uses a poison gas on him. Luffy seems to have the advantage in the fight until Krieg pulls out his explosive Battle Spear.

episodes.title: Outcome of a Deadly Battle! The Spear Inside!
episodes.summary: Even after taking several hits from the Battle Spear, Luffy refuses to give up.

episodes.title: Departure! Sea Chef and Luffy Travel Together!
episodes.summary: After the battle, Gin decides to go back to the Grand Line with Krieg despite still being poisoned, and Sanji makes the difficult decision on whether to stay or to go with Luffy just as Yosaku comes back with news that he knows where Nami is.

episodes.title: The Most Wicked Man of East Blue, Fishman Pirate Arlong
episodes.summary: The crew chases after Nami, who stole their ship, and Yosaku takes time during the trip to explain about Arlong and his Fishmen to Luffy and Sanji. Meanwhile, Usopp, Johnny, and Zoro arrive at the island Nami docked at.

episodes.title: The Witch of Cocoyashi Village, Arlong's Female Officer
episodes.summary: Zoro is captured by the fishmen after Usopp and Johnny ditch him, and it's revealed that Nami was part of Arlong's crew the entire time. When a group of Fishmen attack Cocoyashi Village, Usopp comes to the rescue.

episodes.title: Usopp Dead?! When is Luffy Going to Make Landfall?!
episodes.summary: After Zoro escapes with Nami's help, she tries to prove her loyalty to the Arlong Pirates by appearing to kill Usopp. Meanwhile, Luffy's group finally arrives at the island.

episodes.title: Reunited! Usopp Tells Nami's True Story
episodes.summary: Johnny tells the others about Nami killing Usopp, and Luffy does not believe them until Nami appears herself and confirms it. She tells them to stay out of her business and leave without her, but Luffy stubbornly decides to stay on the island. Usopp returns, revealing that Nami only pretended to kill him, and Nami's sister, Nojiko, starts to explain why Nami is acting the way she is.

episodes.title: The Hidden Past! Female Fighter Bellemere!
episodes.summary: Nojiko starts her story about Nami's childhood and their adopted mother, Bellemere. Despite being poor and none of them being related by blood, they had a happy life.

episodes.title: Survive! The Mother Bellemere and Nami's Family!
episodes.summary: Nojiko continues her story, explaining how their life was ruined when the Arlong Pirates first took over the village.

episodes.title: Luffy Stands Up! End of a Broken Promise!
episodes.summary: When a marine officer under Arlong's pay confiscates all the money Nami stole over the years, in order to one day buy the village from Arlong, the villagers decide that enough is enough and fight back, despite Nami's pleads that they do not and that they'd all be killed. Upon seeing Nami's sorrow, the Straw Hats head for Arlong Park.

episodes.title: Luffy in Trouble! Fishmen vs. Luffy Pirates!
episodes.summary: The Straw Hats face the Fishmen themselves as the villagers watch from the sidelines.

episodes.title: Luffy Drowning! Zoro vs. Octopus Hatchan!
episodes.summary: Arlong has trapped Luffy in the ocean and Zoro faces the six-sword wielding octopus Hatchan.

episodes.title: Proud, Tall Warriors! Dramatic Battle of Sanji and Usopp!
episodes.summary: With Hatchan defeated, two of the fishmen battle Sanji and Usopp. Things look grim for Sanji as he attempts to face Kuroobi underwater, and Usopp gets the chance to prove that he too is a brave warrior.

episodes.title: Luffy's Best! Nami's Courage and the Straw Hat
episodes.summary: Arlong's officers have been defeated, but Sanji and Zoro prove to be no match for Arlong in their current state. However, with Luffy finally free, he just may be able to defeat the "most wicked man in the East Blue". Meanwhile, Nami finally gathers the courage to face Arlong.

episodes.title: Bursting Out! Fishman Arlong, Fearsome Attack From The Sea!
episodes.summary: Luffy returns to the fight, and the battle with Arlong versus Luffy begins.

episodes.title: End of the Fishman Empire! Nami's My Friend!
episodes.summary: The battle spreads into Arlong Park itself and Arlong is no longer holding back.

episodes.title: Setting Out with a Smile! Farewell, Hometown Cocoyashi Village!
episodes.summary: Arlong's reign of terror is over, and no one has anything on their mind except to party. As the crew celebrates, Nami reflects on her hometown and decides to officially join the Straw Hat Pirates.

episodes.title: Bounty! Straw Hat Luffy Becomes World Famous!
episodes.summary: As a result of defeating Buggy, Krieg and Arlong, Luffy now has the highest bounty in all of East Blue. News quickly spreads to Shanks, who celebrates Luffy's arrival into the world of pirates by partying with Mihawk, despite already being severely hungover.

episodes.title: Following the Straw Hat! Little Buggy's Big Adventure
episodes.summary: After his fight with Luffy, Buggy was sent flying to another island with several body parts missing. Thus, Buggy begins his journey to find his crew and his body parts, making some unlikely friends.

episodes.title: You've Been Waiting For It! The Return of Captain Buggy!
episodes.summary: With Buggy assumed to be dead, his crew fights over who will be the new captain, only to be captured by a tribe of cannibals.

episodes.title: The Town of the Beginning and the End - Arrival at Loguetown
episodes.summary: The crew arrives at the last large town before the entrance to the Grand Line--Loguetown, the place where Gold Roger was both born and executed, where they stock up on supplies and sightsee. As Luffy heads for the execution platform where Roger was killed, old enemies are searching for him.

episodes.title: Sandai Kitetsu and Yubashiri! Zoro's New Swords, and the Female Sergeant Major
episodes.summary: While searching for new swords to replace the ones shattered by Mihawk, Zoro meets a woman named Tashigi, who looks exactly like an older Kuina, who then helps him look.

episodes.title: Usopp vs. Daddy The Father! Showdown at High Noon!
episodes.summary: Usopp manages to anger the daughter of bounty hunter Daddy the Father, and finds his own life at stake. When Daddy discovers that Usopp is the son of Yasopp, the only man to beat him, he challenges him to a duel.

episodes.title: A Burning Culinary Battle? Sanji vs. The Gorgeous Chef
episodes.summary: In order to win a rare fish, Sanji enters a cooking contest and faces a woman named Carmen.

episodes.title: Buggy's Revenge! The Man who Smiles at the Execution Platform!
episodes.summary: Luffy arrives at the execution platform only to be caught in a trap by Buggy and Alvida.

episodes.title: The Legend has Begun! Head to the Grand Line
episodes.summary: Miraculously saved from death by an unnatural green gust and a lightning bolt to Buggy, the Straw Hats rush out of Loguetown, only for Zoro to be stopped by Tashigi and Luffy to be stopped by Captain Smoker.

episodes.title: Foreboding of a New Adventure! The Puzzling Girl, Apis
episodes.summary: On a stormy night a girl called Apis escapes from the Marines and arrives at Straw hat's ship, but the girl upon knowing that they are pirates begins to hide some of the reasons which she is being wanted by the Marines. As the Straw Hats escape from the Marines, they get caught in the Calm Belt.

episodes.title: The Holy Beast! Apis' Secret and the Legendary Island
episodes.summary: The Calm Belt is revealed to have no winds or currents as well as being the home of many giant sea kings. Apis forms a plan with Luffy's help and escapes the sea kings by riding with one's sneeze. Later, the crew reaches Warship Island, where they listen to the soporific story of the island's creation. After following Apis into a cave where a dragon is hidden, Luffy and Nami find the reason why Apis is being chased.

episodes.title: Erik's Raid! Great Escape from Gunkan Island!
episodes.summary: Now that the crew is informed about the reasons for which Apis was followed, they hurry to escape the island so Ryuuji could be saved, but they meet with a foe that wants Ryuuji to himself. Zoro and Usopp bring the ship to a thin rock at the side while Nami and Apis get Ryuuji onto a cart. Luffy and Sanji fight the Marines to buy time for all preparations. In the end, the ship pulls the cart away on the search for Lost Island.

episodes.title: Lone Island in a Distant Sea! The Legendary Lost Island
episodes.summary: After arriving to what might seemed as the Lost Island the Straw hats where looking for, they find an old Temple with paintings that might indicate where the Lost Island really is, and also Eric who has been following them throughout the sea.

episodes.title: Duel in the Ruins! Strained Zoro vs. Erik
episodes.summary: Zoro is left fighting with Eric while Luffy and the gang run to the ship in order to get to Lost Island, but only find more problems.

episodes.title: Luffy, Completely Surrounded! Admiral Nelson's Secret Plan
episodes.summary: At last Admiral Nelson has seen through the ambitions of Eric, but takes it a little too personally and now the mystical dragon's life is in danger.

episodes.title: Those who Soar in the Open Skies! Revival of the 1000 Year Legend
episodes.summary: With his last breath, Ryuuji calls all his fellow dragons, and the Lost Island re-surfaced. Meanwhile Luffy takes out Admiral Nelson and his gang.

episodes.title: Angry Finale! Cross the Red Line!
episodes.summary: After leaving Warship Island the Going Merry is now towards the Grand Line, and the crew now returns to the Great Adventure.

episodes.title: The First Obstacle? Giant Whale Laboon Appears
episodes.summary: Upon entering the Grand Line, the ship is swallowed by a giant whale, inside of which they discover a strange place. In addition, they are not the only ones there.

episodes.title: A Man's Promise, Luffy and the Whale Vow to Meet Again
episodes.summary: After hearing the story of Laboon the whale, Luffy comes up with a clever solution to his problems. From Laboon's caretaker, Crocus, the crew learns more about the Grand Line and how to navigate through it, since compasses are useless there.

episodes.title: A Pirate-Loving Town? Arrival at Whiskey Peak
episodes.summary: Luffy and friends arrive at Whisky Peak, a town of pirate-lovers who hold them a feast.

episodes.title: Exploding Santouryu! Zoro vs. Baroque Works!
episodes.summary: Zoro battles a hundred members of Baroque Works, and discovers there is more to them than meets the eye.

episodes.title: A Serious Fight! Luffy vs. Zoro: The Unexpected Duel!
episodes.summary: Luffy, who does not realize the town is full of bounty hunters, engages in a battle with Zoro after he discovers that Zoro attacked the townsfolk, while Mr. 5 and Miss Valentine head for Princess Vivi.

episodes.title: Deliver Princess Vivi! Luffy Pirates Depart
episodes.summary: Luffy's crew manages to become targets of Crocodile, one of the Shichibukai, and decide to help Princess Vivi. They also meet Miss All-Sunday, the second strongest member of Baroque Works and partner of Crocodile.

episodes.title: Try Hard, Koby! Diary of Koby-Meppo's Marine Struggles
episodes.summary: As Luffy and his crew are sailing in the Grand Line, Koby and Helmeppo are stuck doing odd-jobs for the marines back in East Blue, and encounter Vice-Admiral Garp.

episodes.title: Koby-Meppo's Determination! Vice Admiral Garp's Fatherly Pride
episodes.summary: Vice Admiral Garp mentors Koby and Helmeppo to become marines.

episodes.title: Prehistoric Island! The Shadow Lurking in Little Garden!
episodes.summary: Luffy and friends land on Little Garden, a prehistoric island inhabited by dinosaurs and giants.

episodes.title: Humongous Battle! The Giants Dorry and Brogy!
episodes.summary: Nami and Usopp meet a giant named Brogy, while Luffy and Vivi encounter Brogy's rival, Dorry. The Straw Hats little suspect that Officer Agents of Baroque Works are on their tail.

episodes.title: Luffy's Anger! A Dirty Trick in a Sacred Battle
episodes.summary: Dorry, critically injured by exploding ale, blames the Straw Hats. Luffy is enraged that someone would pull such a cowardly trick to sabotage the giants' honorable duel.

episodes.title: Brogy Wails in Victory! Elbaf's Judgement
episodes.summary: Luffy tries in vain to convince the injured Dorry not to fight Brogy. The Officer Agents who sabotaged Dorry's ale further tamper with the giants' duel.

episodes.title: The Devil's Candle! Tears of Regret and Tears of Anger
episodes.summary: Having subdued the giants, Baroque Works makes their move. Mr. 3 introduces Zoro, Nami, Vivi, and Brogy to the slow torture of becoming living statues of wax.

episodes.title: Luffy Attacked by Magic! Colors Trap
episodes.summary: Luffy attempts to rescue his friends but only accelerates the deadly waxing process. To make matters worse, Miss Goldenweek interferes and reveals her own terrifying ability.

episodes.title: Critical Counterattack! Usopp's Quick Wit and Kaenboshi!
episodes.summary: Usopp frees Luffy from Miss Goldenweek's control. With Karoo's help, Usopp and Luffy rescue the others, who take on Mr. 5 and Miss Valentine. Luffy and Karoo pursue Mr. 3 and Miss Goldenweek into the forest.

episodes.title: Farewell to the Giants' Island! On to Alabasta
episodes.summary: After having a pleasant chat with Mr. 0 and encountering the "Unluckies", Sanji retrieves an Eternal Pose for Arabasta. The crew leaves Little Garden and sets sail for Arabasta.

episodes.title: Nami Is Sick? Beyond the Snow that Falls on the Ocean!
episodes.summary: Nami is sick, but the crew does not have a doctor to help her.

episodes.title: Ambush! The Bliking and Wapol the Tin-man
episodes.summary: While looking for a doctor, the crew meets the pirate Wapol, who attacks them, but only makes Luffy send him flying. Meanwhile Smoker manages to intercept the conversation between Mr. 0 and Sanji and plans to go to Arabasta. Back with the crew they arrive at last to an island only to find out they are not welcome.

episodes.title: A Doctorless Island? Adventure in the Country Without a Name!
episodes.summary: The Straw Hat crew manages to gain the trust of the people that attacked them, and are taken to the village, except for Zoro and Karoo, who guard the ship. Luffy and Sanji must take Nami to the island's sole doctor who lives on a mountain-top. Vivi and Usopp discover the past of the island, and about the pirate Wapol from Dalton.

episodes.title: Ya Happy? The Doctor who is Called a Witch!
episodes.summary: While Sanji and Luffy fight off the wilderness, the islander's worst nightmare turns true, as Wapol returns to the island. The doctor is discovered to be on the other side of the island, and Usopp, Vivi and Dalton rush to find her. Dalton however returns as he hears of Wapol's return.

episodes.title: Dalton's Resolve! Wapol's Forces Land
episodes.summary: Dalton faces Wapol, but only gets himself hit by arrows thrown by his former comrade Chess. An avalanche stops the battle, but injures Sanji. Luffy must carry both Nami and Sanji to the doctor, and begins his ascent.

episodes.title: Island that Lives in Snow! Ascend The Drum Rockies!
episodes.summary: The Lapahn help Luffy escape from Wapol, giving him enough time to climb to the castle where doctor Kureha lives. Vivi, Usopp and Zoro deal with the king's army in order to save Dalton. The recovering Nami meets a strange creature.

episodes.title: The Blue-Nosed Reindeer! Chopper's Secret
episodes.summary: Nami asks Chopper to join the crew, but he is not interested. Kureha tells Nami some of what was Chopper's background. After realizing the abilities that Chopper has, Luffy is eager to make him join the crew.

episodes.title: Dream of the Outcasts! The Quack Doctor Hiruluk
episodes.summary: Doctorine continues to tell how Chopper lived his life and how the quack doctor Hiriluk took care of him.

episodes.title: Hiruluk's Cherry Blossoms and Inherited Will
episodes.summary: More of Chopper's past is revealed, including the fate of doctor Hiriluk and Wapol's cruelties as the king. Meanwhile, Wapol reaches the castle where the crew is residing.

episodes.title: VS. Wapol's Army Corps! The Abilities of the Baku Baku Fruit!
episodes.summary: Wapol is determined to bring down Hiriluk's flag, and to do that, he engages Sanji, Luffy and Chopper in a fight.

episodes.title: Devil's Fruit of the Zoan Family! Chopper's Seven-Level Transformation
episodes.summary: Chopper demonstrates the abilities of Rumble Balls when fighting Chessmarimo. Dalton is uncovered from the avalanche.

episodes.title: When the Kingdom's Rule is Over! The Flag of Conviction Lasts Forever
episodes.summary: After trying every trick in the castle, Wapol is finally hunted down by Luffy. The villagers along with Zoro, Vivi and Usopp start their ascent to the castle through a ropeway.

episodes.title: Hiruluk's Cherry Blossoms! Miracle of the Drum Rockies
episodes.summary: After finally been convinced to join the team, Chopper announces his intentions to Dr. Kureha, who does not take it too well; but after escaping from the castle, she has decided to give the whole Straw Hat crew a farewell gift.

episodes.title: Farewell, Drum Island! I'm Going Out to Sea!
episodes.summary: Chopper joins the Straw Hat crew as they continue their journey to Vivi's homeland.

episodes.title: The Hero of Alabasta and the Ballerina on Deck
episodes.summary: Crocodile appears to stop rampaging pirates. Luffy and his crew meet Mr. 2 Bon Kurei, who shows off his Devil Fruit power; Vivi sees a shocking sight.

episodes.title: Coming to the Desert Kingdom! The Rain-Calling Powder and the Rebel Army
episodes.summary: Luffy separates from the rest of the crew, right after arriving at Arabasta's port city of Nanohana. The crew dons disguises while Luffy learns of Dance Powder.

episodes.title: Reunion of the Powerful! His Name Is Fire Fist Ace
episodes.summary: While in Nanohana, the Straw Hats encounter Smoker and Tashigi. A powerful pirate named Portgas D. Ace appears, and is revealed to be Luffy's older brother.

episodes.title: Ace and Luffy! Warm Memories and Brotherly Bonds
episodes.summary: Ace fights Smoker while the Straw Hats run for their ship. Luffy reunites with his brother, and together take down agents of Baroque Works.

episodes.title: The Green City, Erumalu and the Kung Fu Dugongs
episodes.summary: Ace decides to travel with the Straw Hats, as he is hunting for a man known as Blackbeard. The group arrives first at the 'Green City' of Erumalu only to find it abandoned to the desert. Vivi and Nami explain what Dance Powder is and what it has done to Arabasta.

episodes.title: Adventure in the Country of Sand! The Demons that Live in the Scorching Earth
episodes.summary: After leaving Erumalu, the Straw Hats plus Vivi & Ace continue through the desert, facing the many dangers of it.

episodes.title: Here Come the Desert Pirates! The Men who Live Free
episodes.summary: Nami and Vivi found themselves an easier way to travel in the desert and leave all men behind. While trying to catch up with them, Ace gets lost. Luffy and the rest of the gang find the Desert Pirates, and Vivi meets a figure from her past.

episodes.title: Spirit of the Fakes! Heart of the Rebel Army, Kamyu!
episodes.summary: After hearing that a small village has fake Rebel Army bodyguards that have been keeping peace, Vivi asks the men of the crew to test if they are worthy of staying.

episodes.title: Rebel Warrior Kohza! The Dream Sworn to Vivi!
episodes.summary: Still trekking through the Arabasta desert, the crew beats up a giant desert scorpion for lunch, while Vivi tells Nami about her past and her friendship with Koza.

episodes.title: Showdown in a Heat Haze! Ace vs. the Gallant Scorpion!
episodes.summary: Ace finds out that Blackbeard is not in Arabasta after all, and leaves the group to continue looking for him. He leaves Luffy a mysterious piece of paper, explaining that it 'will let them meet again.'

episodes.title: Ruins and Lost Ones! Vivi, Comrades, and the Shape of a Country
episodes.summary: Zoro, Chopper and Luffy manage to get themselves lost and stumble across some huge underground ruins.

episodes.title: At Spiders Cafe: The Enemy Ringleaders Meet at 8 o'clock
episodes.summary: Baroque Works plan starts to take effect, and for that, the Number Agents gather to meet Mr. 0. Meanwhile, crew finds out that the Rebel Army has moved out of Yuba and headed to Katorea, and the rebel leader Koza is determined to attack.

episodes.title: Luffy vs. Vivi! A Tearful Vow for Comrades
episodes.summary: Vivi and Luffy disagree in how to stop the rebel army and Baroque Works, leading to a fight.

episodes.title: The Alabasta War Front! City of Dreams, Rainbase
episodes.summary: The crew travels to the city of Rainbase to take down Crocodile and Baroque Works, but run afoul of Smoker and Tashigi.

episodes.title: Trap in a Desperate Situation! Breaking Into Rain Dinners
episodes.summary: Most of the Straw Hats, along with Smoker, are trapped by Crocodile. Vivi reunites with the royal guardian Pell, but is captured by Miss All-Sunday. Crocodile reveals his invincible Devil Fruit power.

episodes.title: Operation Utopia Commences! The Wave of Rebellion Begins to Move
episodes.summary: Baroque Works' plan to take over Arabasta is set in motion. The king is kidnapped and framed for a crime, and the rebel army begins to move.

episodes.title: The Fearsome Bananawani and Mr. Prince
episodes.summary: Most of the Straw Hats are helplessly trapped, but Crocodile is contacted by "Mr. Prince".

episodes.title: The Key to Turning the Tide and a Great Escape! Doru Doru Ball!
episodes.summary: Chopper distracts Crocodile while Sanji frees the rest of the crew, but find themselves trapped yet again. Smoker's view on Luffy changes a little.

episodes.title: Merciless Fight to the Death! Luffy vs. Crocodile
episodes.summary: After escaping from Rain Dinners, the Straw Hats and Vivi cross the desert to Alubarne, where the final battle will take place. Crocodile, however, manages to catch Luffy, beginning the first round of their battle.

episodes.title: The Miracle Sprint! Alabasta the Animal Land
episodes.summary: Luffy is left for dead by Crocodile, but is helped by the mysteríous Miss All-Sunday. Meanwhile, the rest of the Straw Hats reach Alubarna after encountering the Spot-Billed Duck Squad and dangers of Arabasta's main river.

episodes.title: Rebel Army vs. Royal Army! The Battle will be in Alubarna!
episodes.summary: The revolution is on the verge of starting and the crew comes out with a plan that could stop it.

episodes.title: Alubarna Grieves! The Fierce Captain Karoo!
episodes.summary: Vivi's attempts to stop the rebel army go to waste, and she is attacked by Mr. 2 Bon Kurei, but manages to escape. Meanwhile, the battle of Usopp and Chopper vs. the Mr. 4 team begins.

episodes.title: Swear on Your Comrade's Dream! Battle at Molehill 4th Avenue
episodes.summary: Things look hopeless for Usopp & Chopper as they continue to suffer from every attack that the Mr.4 team makes. However, the tides may be beginning to turn as Usopp learns what it truly means to be a man.

episodes.title: Today's Grand Performance! Mane Mane Montage!
episodes.summary: Albeit severely beaten and bruised, Usopp and Chopper have finally defeated the Mr.4 team. However, Mr. 2 has figured out Sanji's weakness.

episodes.title: Transforming Into Nami! Bon Clay's Hard-Hitting Ballet Kenpo
episodes.summary: Though Mr. 2 discovers Sanji's weakness, Sanji still defeats his opponent after an evenly-matched fight. Meanwhile, before Vivi could give the word to blow up the palace, Crocodile appears.

episodes.title: Nami's Whirlwind Warning! Clima Tact Explosion
episodes.summary: Nami faces off against Miss Doublefinger and tries to figure out her new weapon that Usopp made, the Clima-Tact.

episodes.title: Secret of the Royal Family! The Ancient Weapon, Pluton
episodes.summary: While Crocodile reveals to Vivi about the ancient weapon Pluton, Nami attempts to defeat Miss Doublefinger with her most powerful attack: The Tornado Tempo.

episodes.title: Essence of a Mighty Sword! The Power to Cut Steel and the Breath of All Things
episodes.summary: While Miss. Doublefinger's fight with Nami was challenging, Zoro is having an even more difficult time fighting Mr.1: A man who can change his entire body into steel - something that Zoro cannot cut. As Zoro nears death, he must discover the secret to "the breath of all things".

episodes.title: The Battle is Over! Kohza Flies the White Flag
episodes.summary: When Vivi reveals Crocodile's plan to Koza, he attempts to stop the fighting, but is shot. Crocodile reveals that he has set up a massive bomb in the city.

episodes.title: Vivi's Voice Goes Unheard! A Hero Descends!
episodes.summary: As Koza tries to stop the Rebel Army, both sides are once more fighting due to the intervention of Baroque Works. Vivi is thrown to her certain death when Luffy saves her and challenges Crocodile to a second round.

episodes.title: Sand Crocodile and Water Luffy! Death Match: Round 2
episodes.summary: Luffy fights Crocodile with more success this time by using water, but still loses this round. Meanwhile, the other Straw Hats hurry to locate the bomb before it goes off. Nico Robin forces the king to take her to the tomb where the Pluton Poneglyph is hidden.

episodes.title: Smells Like Croc! Run to the Tomb of the Royal Family, Luffy!
episodes.summary: Crocodile joins Robin in the tomb, and orders her to translate the Poneglyph. Robin tells him that Pluton was not mentioned and that it was only about history, but Crocodile figures out that she was lying and stabs her in response. When Luffy recovers from the last round of fighting, he chases after Crocodile into the tomb.

episodes.title: The Nightmare Draws Near! Secret Base of the Sand Sand Clan
episodes.summary: Luffy fights with Crocodile by using blood on his fists. Meanwhile Vivi finds the bomb, and calls the Straw Hats together.

episodes.title: Magnificent Wings! My Name is Pell, Guardian Spirit of the Kingdom
episodes.summary: Vivi finds the bomb inside of the clock tower, but the Mr. 7 pair of Baroque Works are there to protect it. Vivi defeats them, but she realizes the bomb cannot be stopped so easily. It has a timer, and right before it blows up, Pell shows up and takes it into the atmosphere, where he sacrifices himself to save Arabasta.

episodes.title: I Will Surpass You! Rain Falls on Alabasta!
episodes.summary: Luffy defeats Crocodile by punching him through solid bedrock. When Crocodile falls, the rain-drops calm the soldiers.

episodes.title: A Farewell to Arms! Pirates and a Little Justice
episodes.summary: Now that the battle has ended, the outcome is tallied. Igaram appears with proof of Cobra's innocence, as well as Koza telling everything. Tashigi and Smoker both are rewarded for taking on Crocodile, but neither one of them believes that is right, considering the Straw Hat pirates did all the work.

episodes.title: The Pirates' Banquet and Operation Escape Alabasta!
episodes.summary: Luffy is rescued from the collapsed tomb where he fought Crocodile and brought into Cobra's palace to rest. When he awakens, a magnificent banquet is thrown for the pirates, then, the Straw Hats are invited to enjoy the hot spring steam room inside the palace.

episodes.title: Everything Began that Day! Vivi Tells of her Adventures!
episodes.summary: It's the day for Vivi's speech and her decision whether or not to continue to be with the Straw Hats. Meanwhile, Bon Kurei and his crew attempt to protect the Straw Hats from Hina.

episodes.title: Beware her Scent! The Seventh One is Nico Robin!
episodes.summary: The Marines fail again to catch the Straw Hats. After escaping from Marines, Nico Robin (Ms. All Sunday) appears from inside of Straw Hats ship. She manages to persuade the crew to let her join. Pell is seen at the end standing over his own grave.

episodes.title: The First Patient! Anecdote of the Rumble Ball
episodes.summary: After their adventures in Arabasta, the crew come upon another deserted island and split up tasks amongst themselves. Chopper is left in charge of guarding the ship, and he reminisces about the day he first made the rumble ball and his first patient, Dr. Kureha, while spending some time with the newest crewmember: Nico Robin.

episodes.title: The Navigator's Mutiny! For an Unwavering Dream!
episodes.summary: A weird salesman is fished out of the water and onto the Going Merry, and Nami buys a ton of "1000 year paper" from him to draw her sea maps. However, that's not going to be easy with the rest of the crew goofing off as usual.

episodes.title: Inherited Recipe! Sanji the Curry Expert
episodes.summary: The Going Merry runs into several Marine ships in some fog, and the Straw Hats meet a trainee Marine chef named Tajiyo. Sanji helps him out of a bit of cooking trouble.

episodes.title: I'll Make it Bloom! Manly Usopp's Eight-Shaku Ball
episodes.summary: The crew stops on an island that's having its annual fireworks festival; Usopp meets a young fireworks-maker named Kodama and helps her achieve her dream.

episodes.title: Infamous Pirate Hunter! The Wandering Swordsman, Zoro
episodes.summary: Zoro has a flashback about the time when he first met Johnny and Yosaku, and faced off against Bandits and, Dick.

episodes.title: Zenny Lives on Goat Island and There's a Pirate Ship on his Mountain!
episodes.summary: After escaping from several Marine ships, the Straw Hats land on an uncharted island and meet an old man named Zenny. Chopper finds out that, because of his bad heart, Zenny probably only has three days to live.

episodes.title: How's That for Profit? Money Lender Zenny's Ambition!
episodes.summary: The Straw Hats help Zenny out, hoping to make his last days good ones; they learn about Zenny's past as a money lender, and his dream of becoming a pirate. But Zoro realizes that Zenny has outlived Chopper's predictions and so the straw hats decide that, after helping him finish his pirate ship, they will leave the island.

episodes.title: Where the Island's Treasure Lies! Zenny Pirates Full Charge!
episodes.summary: Zenny decides to follow his dream and become a pirate, despite his age. He helps the Straw Hats out of trouble with the Marines, and then they part ways.

episodes.title: Legend of the Rainbow Mist! Ruluka Island and the Old Man Henzo
episodes.summary: On Ruluka Island, some of the Straw Hats make enemies of the Mayor and his men, who have placed high taxes on everything. Robin, Usopp, and Luffy meet Professor Henzo, who's doing research on the island's rainbow mist. When some of the mist shows up, Henzo borrows the Going Merry to go explore it.

episodes.title: Inhabitants of Neverland! The Pumpkin Pirates!
episodes.summary: The inside of the Rainbow Mist full of wrecked ships and treasure, and is guarded by five kids. The kids are actually friends of Henzo's that got lost in the mist over 50 years ago.

episodes.title: A Longing for Home! The Inescapable Pirate Graveyard!
episodes.summary: Henzo, his friends, and the others try to find a way out of the ship graveyard. Meanwhile, the Mayor and his men let the information about the Rainbow Mist slip to the remaining Straw Hats still on Ruluka.

episodes.title: Frantic Struggle! Whetton's Plans and the Rainbow Tower
episodes.summary: Luffy accidentally propels himself and Rapanui to the end of the mist. Nami appears in the ship graveyard with a rowboat full of treasure and a string connected to the real world, which are both stolen by Wetton's subordinate. The Mayor uses the Rainbow Tower to make a bridge to the Rainbow Mist.

episodes.title: And Then the Legend Begins! To the End of the Rainbow
episodes.summary: The Going Merry escapes from the Rainbow Mist, getting badly damaged on the way. The Mayor gets arrested by a bunch of powerful marines that turn out to be older versions of Henzo's friends, who were thrown 50 years into the past by the Rainbow Mist's collapse.

episodes.title: The Log is Taken! Salvage King, Masira!
episodes.summary: Nami's log pose begins to point to the sky, and the crew finds a map of an island named 'Skypiea' on a 200-year-old ship. They compete with the monkey-like Masira's salvage crew while they search for more clues on how to get there.

episodes.title: Monsters Appear! Don't Touch the Whitebeard Pirates
episodes.summary: The Straw Hats decide to go to Jaya island to look for information on Skypeia. Meanwhile, Ace suddenly shows up on Buggy's ship; Buggy does not let any of his men attack Ace, fearing Whitebeard's retribution.

episodes.title: Stop Dreaming! The City of Ridicule, Mock Town!
episodes.summary: Jaya's main town is full of famous pirates that are constantly brawling with each other. Luffy and Zoro have a run-in with a pirate known as 'Bellamy the Hyena,' who ridicules their dreams and beats them up.

episodes.title: A Pirate's Height! The Man who Talks of Dreams and the King of Underwater Exploration
episodes.summary: Luffy, Zoro and Nami meet the man who is later revealed to be Blackbeard. They leave Mock Town, and get into a fight with Masira's brother Shoujou, another salvage monkey.

episodes.title: The Legendary Family! 'Liar Norland'
episodes.summary: The Straw Hats meet with Mont Blanc Cricket on another part of Jaya; Cricket is a descendant of Montblanc Noland, an infamous "liar" who told of a gold city on Jaya, and Cricket was outcast for looking for artifacts of the gold city. He may be the only person who knows how to get to Skypiea.

episodes.title: Hard Turn to the Clouds! Find the Southbird!
episodes.summary: Cricket explains how the Straw Hats can ride a dangerous vertical current called the Knock-Up Stream to get to Skypeia. However, they first have to catch a southbird to point them toward the point where the stream will erupt from the ocean.

episodes.title: Dreams Don't Come True!? Bellamy vs. The Saruyama Alliance
episodes.summary: While the Straw Hats are looking for a Southbird, Bellamy and his crew attack Cricket's house, and steal the gold artifacts he'd collected over the years from his salvage work. When the Straw Hats return and see what happened, Luffy decides to take a side trip back to Mock Town.

episodes.title: The 100 Million Man! The World's Greatest Authority and the Pirate Blackbeard
episodes.summary: Luffy takes out Bellamy with a single punch. Meanwhile, the world government heads are concerned over Whitebeard, Shanks, and Luffy. The marines try to decide who will replace Crocodile as a Shichibukai - one of Blackbeard's crew shows up uninvited and nominates his captain.

episodes.title: Sail into the Sky! Ride the Knock-Up Stream
episodes.summary: The Going Merry is refitted by Masira and Shoujou to be more flight capable, and the Straw Hats catch a ride on the Knock-Up Stream for Skypeia.

episodes.title: This is the Sea of the Sky! The Knight of the Sky and Heaven's Gate
episodes.summary: The Straw Hats arrive in an ocean above the clouds. Usopp almost falls out of the Going Merry but is saved at the last minute. The crew is also attacked by a mysterious looking warrior, but is saved by the Knight of the Sky. Finally, they arrive at the border which transports them to the upper realm, Skypiea.

episodes.title: Godland Skypiea! The Angels Of the Cloud Beach
episodes.summary: As the crew arrives in Skypiea, they are greeted by Conis and her pet Su. Both she and her father start explaining how the life in Skypiea is and how the different Dials work.

episodes.title: Forbidden Sacred Ground! The Island Where God Resides and Heaven's Judgement!
episodes.summary: Nami finds out what should happen to anyone who enters the forest. Meanwhile, the rest of the gang are waiting for the wind to change but are rudely assaulted by Skypiea's police who are going to carry out Heaven's Judgement.

episodes.title: Already Criminals?! Skypiea's Upholder of the Law!
episodes.summary: The Straw Hats have some problems with the local justice enforcer force called "The White Berets."

episodes.title: Is Escape Possible?!? God's Challenge is Set in Motion
episodes.summary: While trying to escape from Sky Island, Robin, Chopper, Nami and Zoro are held hostages by God Enel.

episodes.title: Trap on Lovely Street! Almighty God Enel
episodes.summary: Conis leads Luffy, Usopp, and Sanji to a boat to get to Upper Yard, but she tells them it is a trap and almost gets hit by "Heaven's Judgment".

episodes.title: Go Forth, Little Crow! To the Sacrificial Altar
episodes.summary: Luffy, Usopp and Sanji finally enter Upper Yard, only to find out that the whole road is trapped heavily, but at last they arrive at the Ordeal Gates. Meanwhile Robin, Zoro, and Nami go out to explore Upper Yard while Chopper stays behind to guard the ship.

episodes.title: 10 Percent Survival Rate! Satori, the Mantra Master!
episodes.summary: Luffy, Sanji, and Usopp enter the Ordeal of Balls gate and encounter the Priest Satori.

episodes.title: Peril of the Ordeal of Balls! Fight to the Death in the Lost Forest
episodes.summary: Usopp, Sanji and Luffy fight Satori, but the power of Mantra seems to be too strong.

episodes.title: Chopper's in Danger! Former God vs. Shinto priest Shura
episodes.summary: Chopper, threatened by priest Shura, blows the whistle for Gan Fall to come, but before he can arrive, Priest Shura assaults Chopper and begins destroying the Going Merry.

episodes.title: Ever Mysterious! Ordeal of String and Ordeal of Love!?
episodes.summary: Gan Fall cannot handle Shura and lost the battle. Meanwhile, Satori is finally defeated by Luffy and Sanji.

episodes.title: Light the Fire of Shandora! Wyper the Warrior
episodes.summary: Chopper is saved by a bunch of giant Southbirds, who tell him that Gan Fall was actually God. Nami, Zoro and Robin discover the reason why Upper Yard is a soil island: It was once part of Jaya, and this is the part that Liar Noland saw. Meanwhile the Shandia attack Upper Yard.

episodes.title: Floating Land of Gold, Jaya! To God's Shrine!
episodes.summary: The Shandia attack on Upper Yard has started. The crew is finally reunited, and everyone speaks up about what has happened. Chopper takes care of Gan Fall, and the pirates plan to steal the gold on the island.

episodes.title: Eve of Gold Festival! Feelings Toward 'Vearth'!
episodes.summary: After befriending a wolf pack, Gan Fall tells the crew a little more about the history of Upper Yard.

episodes.title: God Enel Appears! Aubade to the Survivors
episodes.summary: Enel takes away the limitations of the priests. Also, Usopp witnesses a mysterious person fixing the ship; the next day Merry is found to be back to her original form. After getting her off the altar, the pirates plan out their course of action.

episodes.title: The Python Strikes! The Survival Game Begins
episodes.summary: A giant python makes Luffy, Robin, Chopper and Zoro split while going to the ruins at the south.

episodes.title: The Life-Threatening Reject! War Demon Wiper's Resolve
episodes.summary: Wyper takes out Shura and tells his goal to the Shandia, and Enel speaks up about how many people will be alive by the end of his plan.

episodes.title: Fierce Sky Battle! Pirate Zoro vs. Fighter Braham
episodes.summary: Zoro fights the Shandia warrior Braham, and defeats him with Ittoryu (one sword style) 36 Pound Cannon technique.

episodes.title: The Roaring Burn Bazooka! Luffy vs. War Demon Wyper!
episodes.summary: Luffy fights Wyper, but after some time, he falls into some underground ruins. Meanwhile, Enel appears on the Going Merry and after telling that his true goal was the City of Gold, he takes out both Usopp and Sanji; then he vanishes and leaves Satori's brothers: Hotori and Kotori to avenge him.

episodes.title: Ordeal of Swamp! Pirate Chopper vs Gedatsu!!
episodes.summary: Chopper is attacked by Gedatsu, who turns out to be a complete moron, and eventually defeats him, sending him plummeting to the Blue Sea. Conis and Pagaya help Aisa, and head to Upper Yard.

episodes.title: The Invincible Ability! Enel's True Nature Revealed
episodes.summary: Enel defeats several members of the Shandia Tribe. Meanwhile, Gan Fall and Nami start and finish their fight with Kotori and Hotori. Hotori is defeated by Nami while Kotori is defeated by Gan Fall.

episodes.title: The Vanished City! The Magnificent Ruins of Shandora!!
episodes.summary: While Robin is looking at some ruins she found, Yama, The Chief Enforcer, attacks her. Yama is easily defeated by Robin. Later, she discovers the legendary city, Shandora.

episodes.title: Chance of Survival: 0%!! Pirate Chopper vs. Shinto Priest Ohm
episodes.summary: Priest Ohm appears and starts fighting everyone.

episodes.title: Climb Giant Jack! Deadly Combat in the Upper Ruins
episodes.summary: At the Upper Ruins, the fight between Ohm, Zoro, Gan Fall and Wyper begins. When Nami appears, she is swallowed by the giant python, along with Gan Fall and Aisa.

episodes.title: Ultimate Test of the Ordeal of Iron! The White-Barbed Death Match!!
episodes.summary: Ohm makes matters worse, creating a barbed wire cage around the area. Laki is knocked out by Enel, and Nami, Aisa, and Gan Fall find out why the python was rampaging so much.

episodes.title: Gushing Blade Attack! Pirate Zoro vs Shinto Priest Ohm!!
episodes.summary: Zoro finally defeats Priest Ohm with his 108 Pound Cannon technique. Meanwhile Pagaya and Conis hear the terrible truth about the goal of Enel: to eradicate every person in the sky.

episodes.title: The Upper Ruins Crumble! The Quintet Finale!!
episodes.summary: Enel appears only to reduce the group as close to his prediction as he can.

episodes.title: Battle in the Ancient Ruins! God Enel's Desire!!
episodes.summary: Enel counterattacks Gan Fall and lands a finishing hit. He then knocks out Robin as she tries to manipulate him. Zoro impresses Enel with his power but is easily beaten, while trying to make him pay for what he did to Robin; but it takes Wyper with a secret weapon to take Enel down.

episodes.title: Ambitions of Fairy Vearth - The Ark, Maxim!!
episodes.summary: Enel defeats Zoro and Wyper. Upon seeing this, Nami follows him to a cave where his ark, Maxim, is. Luffy finally gets out of the snake, along with Aisa, only to find out the outcome of the fight against Enel. When Aisa tells him that she knows where he is, he asks her to take him there.

episodes.title: Finally Clashing! Pirate Luffy vs God Enel!!
episodes.summary: Luffy and Enel start fighting. Conis tells the dangers of staying in Sky Island to the other Skypieans.

episodes.title: Maxim Rises! The Start of Deathpiea!!
episodes.summary: The fight between Enel and Luffy continues with Enel starting a machine that would bring the death of Skypiea: Deathpiea.

episodes.title: Luffy's Fall! God's Judgement and Nami's Desire!!
episodes.summary: Luffy falls from the ark. Nami starts fighting Enel while Sanji and Usopp try to rescue her.

episodes.title: Two People Awaken! A Rescue in Front of Burning Love!!
episodes.summary: Usopp and Sanji split up to rescue Nami, but the first one to get on deck is Usopp.

episodes.title: Capriccio to Destruction! The Impending Doom of Sky Island!!
episodes.summary: Enel's thunderclouds are coming down to Sky Island while the evacuation is half complete.

episodes.title: Guidance from the Sound of a Bell! The Great Warrior and Tales of an Explorer
episodes.summary: The history of Noland and Kalgara is told, as a flashback from Wyper.

episodes.title: Released from Disgrace! The Tears of the Great Warrior!!
episodes.summary: Noland and Kalgara are enjoying themselves, as well as the villagers and Noland's crew, but that changes one day, as the villagers start hating their new friends.

episodes.title: Eternal Friendship! The Bell of Oath Echoes Throughout the Giant Ocean!!
episodes.summary: The cause of the hatred is discovered and explained. Meanwhile, Kalgara vows to meet Noland again.

episodes.title: The Destruction of Angel Island! Terror of The Descending Raigou!!
episodes.summary: Angel Island is destroyed by Enel's attacks. Luffy decides to go and ring the golden bell before Enel takes it away.

episodes.title: Chop Down Giant Jack! The Last Hope of Escaping
episodes.summary: Nami finds out a way to get to Enel, by cutting down Giant Jack. Wyper finds out from Robin that Noland has a descendant that is searching for the Gold City, and that's the reason why Luffy wants to ring the Golden Bell.

episodes.title: The Miracle in God's Country! A Love Song Heard by Angels
episodes.summary: Luffy defeats Enel, ringing the Golden Bell in the process.

episodes.title: The Battle Ends! Proud Fantasia Echoes Far!
episodes.summary: The 400 year war on Sky Island comes to an end. Montblanc Cricket and the Masira Brothers hear the Golden Bell ringing and realize that the Gold City was always in the sky. Enel, who was thrown to the Blue Sea heads out to the Fairy Vearth (the Moon). The Sky People (both Skypieans and Shandia) celebrate the end of the war with a great bonfire.

episodes.title: I Have Come Here! The Weaving of the Poneglyphs
episodes.summary: Robin deciphers the poneglyphs on the Golden Bell and realizes how to find the Rio Poneglyph. She also discovers that the poneglyphs on the Bell were written by Gol D. Roger, who could understand poneglyphs, who had discovered the Rio Poneglyph, and had once visited Skypiea. Soon afterwards, the Straw Hats steal a bunch of gold from the Giant Anaconda's belly and they begin to leave Skypiea.

episodes.title: Now Heading Towards the Blue Sea! Memories of an Interwoven Finale
episodes.summary: The Golden Bell rings as the Straw Hats are going down to the sea, meaning that they are welcome and are deeply thankful for what they did. When the ship finally rests on the sea, problems appear, as the ship has landed in a Marine base.

episodes.title: Emergency Announcement! An Infamous Pirate Ship has Invaded!
episodes.summary: The Marines are convinced the Going Merry is a ghost ship after it crashes inside their fortress from above. The crew members are scattered around the premises.

episodes.title: Sanji the Chef! Demonstrating True Pride at the Marine Mess Hall!
episodes.summary: In disguise, Sanji shows the Marine chefs the proper way to prepare a meal.

episodes.title: Zoro's Imprisonment and Chopper's Emergency Operation!
episodes.summary: Zoro is taken prisoner as Chopper and Nami assist a nervous doctor in treating injured Marines.

episodes.title: The Marine Search Party Draws Near! Another of the Crew is Captured!
episodes.summary: Robin and Usopp both disguise themselves as the same visiting inspector, and Usopp is thrown in the brig with Zoro. Luffy and Sanji are discovered by Jonathan after a slight mishap.

episodes.title: Luffy and Sanji's Determination! The Great Escape Plan!
episodes.summary: The real Inspector is thrown in the brig with Zoro and Usopp, while Sanji and Luffy race to rescue the two while avoiding detection.

episodes.title: The Squadron of Burning Souls Attack! Battle on the Bridge!
episodes.summary: Sanji and Luffy, after freeing Usopp and Zoro, try to escape Navarone. As the Burning Soul combat unit is deployed, Dr. Kobato leads Nami and Chopper to the docks.

episodes.title: Breaking Through Enemy Lines! The Rescue of the Going Merry!
episodes.summary: The crew meets at the docks and are surrounded by Marines. Using Nami as their fake hostage, they trick the Marines into letting them back on the Going Merry.

episodes.title: The Pirate Ship Disappears! Stronghold Battle, Round 2
episodes.summary: The crew disguises the Going Merry as a Marine ship so they can get their treasure back. With the gold, they decide they'll hire a shipwright.

episodes.title: Operation Gold Recovery and Operation Waver Retrieval!
episodes.summary: Usopp splits up the crew into two teams: the gold retrieval team and the waver retrieval team. Inspector Shepherd decides to catch Luffy on his own.

episodes.title: The Pirate Round-Up Plan! Jonathon's Secret Winning Strategy!
episodes.summary: The Straw Hats continue to search for their treasure. Luffy leads Nami to the captain's quarters where they retrieve their gold.

episodes.title: So Long, Marine Base! The Final Battle for Freedom
episodes.summary: The Going Merry is grounded during a period of low tide and Jonathan believes they've reached "checkmate". They cleverly use the impact dial to boost the ship and the breath and flame dials to inflate the octopus balloon again so they can escape.

episodes.title: Big Adventure in Long Ring Long Land
episodes.summary: Luffy and company come across a mysterious pirate ship after trying to escape a giant wave. Soon, they arrive on an island inhabited by strange animals. Going Merry is captured by the Foxy Pirate crew.

episodes.title: The Foxy Pirate Crew and the Davy Back!
episodes.summary: After Tonjit re-unites with his horse, they are soon attacked by Captain Foxy and his subordinates, who challenge Luffy in a Davy Back Fight, a contest of pirates where the stakes are members of the crew.

episodes.title: Round 1! One Lap of the Donut Race
episodes.summary: The first round of Davy Back Fight involves a race around the island with tiny boats. Zoro's and Chopper's boat is eliminated.

episodes.title: Foxy the Silver Fox! A Violent Interference
episodes.summary: With only Luffy, Nami, and Porche's boat remaining, it's an all out war to the goal, but after Foxy exposes his Devil Fruit powers, Porche wins and takes Tony Tony Chopper from Luffy. The second round prepares to start.

episodes.title: Round 2! Shoot into the Groggy Ring!
episodes.summary: Without Chopper, Sanji and Zoro must face the Foxy Pirates in a ball game, but are hampered by their blatant cheating and the crooked referee.

episodes.title: Rapid-Fire Red Cards! Groggy Ring
episodes.summary: The bickering rivals Sanji and Zoro manage to overcome the opposing team by working together. Luffy chooses Tonjit's horse, Shelly over Chopper.

episodes.title: Round 3! Round and Round Roller Race!
episodes.summary: The Straw Hats face Foxy a race around a giant ring on roller skates.

episodes.title: Burning Roller Race! Dash into the Final Round!
episodes.summary: The Straw Hat Pirates stop Foxy and his dirty tricks and win the race.

episodes.title: The Screaming Speed Serve! Pirate Dodgeball!
episodes.summary: With Luffy's victory, he takes Chopper back, but foolishly accepts another challenge by Foxy.

episodes.title: Final Match on the Edge! Dharma has Fallen!
episodes.summary: Foxy decides to take Robin from Luffy this time because of her Devil Fruit ability. The next match is a race to the top of the island.

episodes.title: Captain Confrontation! The Last Fight: Combat!
episodes.summary: With Chopper gone again from Luffy's crew, Luffy and Foxy face off in the final game: a battle of brawn aboard Foxy's ship.

episodes.title: Full Power Noro Noro Beam vs The Invulnerable Luffy
episodes.summary: Luffy continues to battle Foxy with the odds not in his favor, and the fight continues inside Foxy's ship.

episodes.title: Heroic Fierce Combat! The Fateful Last Battle
episodes.summary: Luffy manages to finally defeat Foxy by using his ability against him. After dismissing his new crewmembers, the Straw Hats leave in search for a shipwright.

episodes.title: Lost? Stolen? Who are You?
episodes.summary: A mysterious figure appears during the night and steals the memories of the crew. In the morning, Robin is the only one who remembers the Straw Hats adventures together. Her attempts to keep the crew together fail as Nami and Zoro go separate ways.

episodes.title: The Mysterious Boy with the Whistle and Robin's Guess
episodes.summary: Robin suggests that only those who were sleeping lost their memories. Luffy and the others then remember seeing the mysterious boy who played some kind of flute. Later that night, they discover the boy outside and Luffy tries to fight him. At the last second, he proclaims his memory has returned.

episodes.title: Get Back the Memories! The Pirates Land
episodes.summary: During the night, Usopp, Chopper, and Sanji question what brought them to the Going Merry. In the morning, Usopp builds them a raft and they sail to the island where they meet Nami again. Meanwhile, the boy sets his sights on Zoro.

episodes.title: Zoro Sharpens His Fangs! A Fight with a Wild Animal
episodes.summary: On their way to "The Palace of the Sea God" Robin's group meets an entranced Zoro. It looks like Zoro wants to fight so Luffy urges the others to keep going without him. They apprehend the kid but the whistle was what was really stealing their memories. Zoro returns, still entranced, but Luffy's nowhere to be seen.

episodes.title: The Real Memory Thief's Final Counterattack!
episodes.summary: Luffy returns and knocks some sense into Zoro. Cornered, the sea horse spreads illusions of the people in their memories to distract them. It steals their complete memories and claims that it has become a Sennenryu. Luffy defeats it and returns all the memories but the townspeople are convinced they are the memory stealers.

episodes.title: The Man of Pride! Foxy the Silver Fox
episodes.summary: Luffy rescues Foxy, Hamburg, and Porche from a storm at sea. When they reunite with the Sexy Foxy ship, they find it captained by somebody new. Foxy accepts a Davy Back Fight in order to regain his ship and crew. Donning the afro once again, Luffy vows to defeat the captain.

episodes.title: The Unbeatable Power Draws Near? A Very Dangerous Man!
episodes.summary: Once Foxy wins back his crew, he captures the Straw Hats. Nami and Luffy fight Foxy and although he's defeated, his crew accepts him back. Later, they sail to an island where they meet someone Robin knows: a Marine named Aokiji.

episodes.title: Marine High Admiral Aokiji! The Threat of the Greatest Power
episodes.summary: The man they met, Marine High Admiral Aokiji, appears to be incredibly lazy. He first displays his Devil's Fruit ability by freezing the sea so some deserted people can get off the island. Unfortunately, he's determined to catch Robin. Luffy, Sanji, and Zoro attack but they seem to be no match.

episodes.title: Rubber and Ice One-On-One Fight! Luffy vs Aokiji!
episodes.summary: Luffy insists on fighting Aokiji alone and risks it all so the crew can save the frozen Robin.

episodes.title: Running Sea Train! The City of Water, Water 7
episodes.summary: After the Going Merry narrowly escapes being hit by a Sea Train, the crew meets an old woman, Kokoro, and her granddaughter, Chimney. Kokoro gives Luffy a map to Water 7.

episodes.title: The Adventure in the City of Water! Aim for the Giant Shipyard
episodes.summary: Luffy, Nami, and Usopp get strange greetings from the residents and they get to experience the roller coaster-like channels of Water 7. Luffy's group finds out that some pirates had been beaten at the hands of some powerful craftsmen; the Galley La Company. Chopper loses Robin and some strange new people threaten Zoro back on the ship.

episodes.title: The Franky Family and Iceburg!
episodes.summary: The people who attacked Zoro reveal themselves to be the feared "Franky Family", though they are no match for Zoro. Luffy's group has the gold exchanged for cash. After, they meet a man who resembles Usopp, Galley La's carpenter employment foreman, Kaku. Two of the suitcases of money are stolen by the Franky Family.

episodes.title: Galley-La Company! The Magnificent Dock #1
episodes.summary: Paulie makes his debut when he retrieves Usopp's stolen money as he runs from debt collectors. Kalifa shows Luffy, Nami, and Usopp around Dock No.1 and tells them how Iceburg founded the Galley La Company. Kaku returns from the Going Merry and tells them that their keel is irreparably damaged.

episodes.title: The Pirate Kidnapping Incident and the Pirate Ship Waits for Death!
episodes.summary: Luffy refuses to believe that Galley La cannot repair the Going Merry. The two soon realize that not only is Usopp missing now, the two brief cases that were returned to them are empty! Nami decides to head to Franky House and finds Usopp on the way in a pitiful state. As she heads back to the ship for help, Usopp goes to the Franky House himself.

episodes.title: Rescuing a Friend! The Raid on the Franky House
episodes.summary: Luffy, Sanji, Zoro, and Chopper follow Usopp's bloody trail to the Franky House where they find him passed out in front. The four of them challenge the Franky Family only to find out that their real target, Franky himself, is gone and has taken the money with him.

episodes.title: Quarrel in the Moonlight! The Pirate Ship Trembles in Sadness
episodes.summary: Once they are back on the ship, Luffy has to finally tell Usopp that the Going Merry can no longer be repaired and that they've chosen to get a new ship without him. Usopp believes that Luffy has abandoned the dignity of their ship and says he's leaving the crew. That night, he challenges Luffy to a duel.

episodes.title: Luffy vs Usopp! The Spirit of the Clashing Men
episodes.summary: Usopp fights Luffy in order to decide who keeps the Going Merry; he fights harder than he's ever fought before. Luffy actually seems to pose no threat but all the while, he's remembering what great friends they used to be, sailing together on the same ship.

episodes.title: The City of Water is Shaking! Iceburg was Targeted!
episodes.summary: The Straw Hats get themselves a hotel room. Nami finds the crew on the roof with urgent news; Iceburg has been shot. As the Galley La Company frantically search for answers, Nami and Luffy decide to check on his condition - only to be met by closed gates. Franky appears then to exact his revenge - with style.

episodes.title: Rubberman vs Fire-Breathing Cyborg
episodes.summary: In the streets outside of the hospital, Luffy fights Franky. Inside, Iceburg recalls seeing Nico Robin and another tall man before he was shot. The Galley La company run outside and stop Franky and Luffy and tell them that they suspect the Straw Hat Pirates of the crime.

episodes.title: The Criminals are the Straw Hat Pirates? The Bodyguards of Water 7
episodes.summary: The Galley La Company continues to fight Luffy and Franky is enraged that they've stolen his opponent. An incredibly high tide called the "Aqua Laguna" is coming and Chopper and Sanji rush to warn Usopp. Luffy raises some chaos in order to meet with Iceburg and he demands to know what's happening. Iceburg says he wants to see Robin one more time.

episodes.title: An Eternal Farewell? Nico Robin, The Woman Who Bears Darkness
episodes.summary: In a bar, Franky talks with Kokoro about her theory on who shot Iceburg. The rumors she speaks of seem to have some truth as we see Robin meeting with someone from an organization called CP9. While the crew hide from angry residents, Sanji and Chopper discover Robin and she tells them what they've feared: she's responsible and she wants to part ways.

episodes.title: Catch Robin! The Determination of the Straw Hat Pirates
episodes.summary: Chopper reunites with the others without Sanji and they discuss what's happened. Luffy decides that in order to know the full truth, they must catch Robin. Usopp attempts to repair the ship enough to withstand the Aqua Laguna and the Straw Hats make their way to the Galley La Company.

episodes.title: The Signal is the Explosion! CP9 Starts to Move
episodes.summary: The Straw Hats (still missing Sanji) rush to Galley La where Robin and CP9 begin a raid. In Iceburg's room, Robin and the mysterious man Iceburg saw before, tell him that they've purposely placed the blame on the pirates. Their true aim is the blueprints he would've passed down to Paulie. Luffy separates from his group.

episodes.title: CP9 Unmasked! Their Shocking True Faces
episodes.summary: Robin speaks with Iceburg inside his room still. We already know that Robin can read the poneglyphs - and it seems Iceburg is the one with the blueprints to the ultimate weapon, Pluton. The true enemies are revealed to be Iceburg's own allies. Elsewhere, Luffy is tied up with Paulie after Paulie tells members of CP9 that his blueprints are fake.

episodes.title: The Secret Bond! Franky and Iceburg
episodes.summary: Lucci tells Iceburg their hypothesis and has Kaku check his pulse to tell if the things he tells him are true. They suspect that Iceburg's friend from the past, Cutty Flam, is really Franky and it's revealed to be true. Therefore, Franky has the real blueprints. The Straw Hat Pirates and Paulie break into the room where they find Iceburg and CP9.

episodes.title: Come Back, Robin! The Confrontation with CP9
episodes.summary: Luffy and the others request that Robin comes back to the crew. She refuses and tells them that she cannot accomplish her "wish" if she were to stay with them. Robin turns to leave and CP9 try to hold the pirates back. Robin successfully escapes and Lucci shows those remaining his "transformation".

episodes.title: Destruction of the Straw Hat Pirates? The Terror of the Model Leopard!
episodes.summary: Lucci's transformation is a result of a Devil's Fruit; a Zoan Type leopard. He quickly disposes of the crew and CP9 tie up Paulie and Iceburg, leaving them alone as the building slowly burns down around them. In Franky's underground hideout, Usopp tells him his story and Franky is finally touched. In return, Franky tells him a little about Tom's contributions to Water 7.

episodes.title: The Man who is Loved by his Ship! Usopp's Tears!
episodes.summary: Usopp believes that the person who repaired the Going Merry in Skypeia was really the Going Merry itself. Franky says that the ship was inhabited by a spirit who enters ships who are dearly cared for. The spirit repaired their ship just enough for them to reach the next island. The doorbell rings from the sea side and CP9 enter.

episodes.title: Franky's Past! The Day the Sea Train Ran
episodes.summary: CP9 discover Franky's hidden room and he fears they'll trample his memories. A long flashback ensues, covering Franky's past in Tom's Workers and how he and Iceburg helped create the Sea Train.

episodes.title: Spandam's Conspiracy! The Day the Sea Train Shook
episodes.summary: (Franky's flashback) Spandam, a CP5 representative, was determined to get Tom proven guilty in his trial so he could get the blueprints. As Franky walked into the town, people from the government began to attack with the battleships he had personally constructed. Tom and Iceburg run to their shipyard where they are attacked by two ships which also destroy the others. Iceburg tells Franky that he has to take responsibility or he will never forgive him.

episodes.title: The End of the Legendary Man! The Day the Sea Train Cried
episodes.summary: (Franky's flashback) Franky said that if a ship of his were to be used as a weapon, then it's no longer one of his ships. That enraged Tom and he punched Franky for the first time, telling him he had to take pride in the ships he created. He then told the judge that he would accept the punishment for both his previous crime and the recent attack. Franky tried to stop the train to Enies Lobby with his bare hands.

episodes.title: The Truth Behind the Betrayal! Robin's Sorrowful Decision!
episodes.summary: Chopper escapes the burning building with Paulie and Iceburg on his back and collapses outside. Iceburg makes it clear to Nami that Robin wanted to recover the blueprints and to do that, she wanted her companions to leave the island without her. Nami rushes to tell Chopper so they can go looking for the rest of the crew. Elsewhere, the foremen let go of the Going Merry so she would be destroyed at sea.

episodes.title: The Steam Whistle Separates the Group! The Sea Train Begins to Run
episodes.summary: Paulie helps clear the name of the Straw Hats but does not tell the mob everything he knows. He gets the mob to follow Chopper so they can search for the rest of the crew. Nami goes her own way so she can rush to the Sea Train. As Nami nears the station, Sanji, ahead of her, approaches the train.

episodes.title: Sanji Breaks In! The Sea Train Battle in the Storm!
episodes.summary: Nami and the conductors are rescued by Paulie when the Aqua Laguna floods the main station. A man hands Nami a letter he found from Sanji. It informs her that Usopp, Franky, and he are on board the train that had just departed. On board, he storms the cars. High up in the city, Nami speaks with Kokoro and spots Luffy, stuck in between two buildings, in the back streets where the Aqua Laguna will hit first.

episodes.title: The Shout of Nami's Soul! The Return of the Straw Hat!
episodes.summary: Nami finally reaches Luffy and tells him that he needs to hurry before Robin reaches Enies Lobby. Chopper finds Zoro and hands him the Sandai Kitetsu so he can escape the chimney. Luffy pushes apart the buildings he was stuck between and Paulie grabs them all so they can escape the Aqua Laguna's massive wave.

episodes.title: Another Sea Train! Rocket Man Sortie
episodes.summary: Sanji fights his way through another train car and finds Usopp and Franky. Seeing how determined Luffy is to save Robin, Kokoro and Iceburg lends the Straw Hat crew the use of another sea train, Rocket Man. The Franky Family shows up, pleading with Luffy to let them join them because they'll do anything for their leader.

episodes.title: Rescue our Friends! The Oath that Links the Enemies
episodes.summary: The Rocket Man finally makes it out to sea. As the train connects with the tracks, Luffy has to rescue Chimney before she's thrown off by the wind. In the meantime, Iceburg has a flashback about when he finally met Franky again in Water 7. With Luffy and Chimney safe in the train, Paulie tells his fellow carpenters who the real culprits were. The Straw Hats, Franky Family, and Galley La Company form an alliance.

episodes.title: Smash the Wave! Luffy and Zoro, The Strongest Combo!
episodes.summary: Luffy and Zoro perform a move that acts similar to a cannon and blasts a hole through the wall of the tidal wave ahead of them, opening up a channel for them to pass through. They miraculously pass through unscathed and the passengers rejoice. Sanji contacts the rest of the crew and fills them in on his current situation. Usopp separates from them but later, when Sanji and Franky are spotted, a man named Sogeking comes to their rescue.

episodes.title: A Mysterious Man Appears?! His Name Is Sogeking!
episodes.summary: Sogeking makes his grand entrance. Franky and Sanji aren't fooled by his costume but they try to humor him. They devise a plan first, then detach the last two cars and fight their way through the rest. Back in the Rocket Man, Luffy, Zoro, Nami, and Chopper get an outfit change; Nami shows off the weapon Usopp upgraded for her while he was still with them.

episodes.title: Cook Confrontation! Sanji vs Ramen Kenpo
episodes.summary: Kalifa updates the CP9 on the situation with Franky, Sanji, and Usopp. Sanji tells Franky and Usopp to go on without him so he can fight Wanze and his "Ramen Kenpo". Franky begins to fight Nero, CP9's "Weasel", and Sogeking meets with Robin.

episodes.title: Duel on the Roof! Franky vs Nero!
episodes.summary: Franky's fight with Nero continues. Nero discovers that Franky's weak spot is his back, so Franky lies down flat so he cannot get to it. Nero demands that he fight seriously, so Franky gets up to perform his "Centaur" form. Sogeking talks with Robin and tells her that the crew knows about her reasons for leaving. Those on the Rocket Man encounter the discarded cars and Zoro slices them so they can pass.

episodes.title: Crash! Demon-Cutting Zoro vs Ship-Cutting T-Bone!
episodes.summary: Zoro clashes with "Ship Cutter" T-Bone. The fight is short and Zoro joins the crew again in the Rocket Man. On the Puffing Tom, Sanji beats Wanze beautiful, though Wanze thinks he's ruined his face. Franky finally gains the upper hand against Nero and defeats him. After beating their respective opponents, Franky and Sanji stand to fight against the other CP9.

episodes.title: Robin Struggles! Sogeking's Clever Scheme!!
episodes.summary: After hiding under Robin's cloak for a few episodes, Sogeking finally shows himself. They stumble into the room with the CP9 and meet with Sanji and Franky. Sogeking produces a smokescreen. The four head into another car, detach it, and escape. It's not long before Blueno pulls their car back, though. Franky knocks down the wall so they can escape but ends up on the enemy car. Blueno opens a door then back in the Straw Hat car.

episodes.title: The Judiciary Island! The Full Picture of Enies Lobby!
episodes.summary: Robin willingly follows Blueno into his improvised door and Sogeking and Sanji are left alone. For a while, Blueno explains a little of Robin's past involving the Buster Call. Back at the Rocket Man, Yokuzuna the frog jumps onto the front of the train, knocking them from the rails. After Kokoro speaks with him, he joins the group. The CP9, Franky, and Robin finally reach Enies Lobby and disembark.

episodes.title: Operation Disembarkation Commences! The Straw Hat Crew Rushes In!
episodes.summary: Luffy and the others finally catch up to Sanji, Usopp, and the rest of the Franky Family as they near Enies Lobby. Paulie sits down with the group and talks about their plan. Luffy does not bother to follow the plan, and slingshots himself beyond the gates before the train stops.

episodes.title: Luffy Charges In! Great Decisive Battle on the Judiciary Island!
episodes.summary: Spandam is informed that an intruder has entered the area. Luffy confuses the Marines guarding the entrance gate by manipulating one of their own comrades to fight against them. The rest of Luffy's group come in after he already slingshot himself over the gates. Because they aren't all quite as limber as Luffy, they have to band together to get inside. Giant Gate Keepers Kaashii and Oimo come to fight the Franky Family.

episodes.title: Battle with the Giants! Open the Second Door!
episodes.summary: In a David and Goliath turn around, the Franky Family and Galley La bring down Kaashi. Spandam receives an incomplete report about Luffy and believes that he's no longer a threat. The Cipher Pol 9 members meet with Spandam and it looks more like a comedy routine than a briefing.

episodes.title: The Means of Escaping is Opened! Fly through the Sky, Rocketman!
episodes.summary: While Robin and Franky are brought before Spandam, Luffy blasts his way through another wave of marines. In order to get past the gate, Zoro orders that they just keep going. Yokozuna the frog bends down the outside gates and they fly over the gate inside. Back on the ground, Paulie is stabbed by someone from "The Law's Watch Dogs", the Houbantai. The Rocket Man flies over the gate and the point of the train smashes into Oimo's back, knocking him out cold.

episodes.title: Catch Up with Luffy! The Straw Hat Pirates' All-Out War
episodes.summary: As the title of the episode suggests, the Straw Hats enter an all-out war to catch up with Luffy, albeit a humorous one; Sanji and Zoro bicker over who's more dangerous, Nami injures her own comrades with her improved weapon, and Sogeking fails at being a decoy. The Houbantai show up to stop them and the foremen of Galley La stay behind to fight.

episodes.title: Robin was Betrayed! The Expectations of the World Government!
episodes.summary: Robin questions why Spandam was given rights to the Buster Call. The CP9 plan to kill the Straw Hats because they violated the original arrangement; that they entered Enies Lobby after leaving Water 7. Back in the fray, Franky's Giant Bulls talk with Chopper. He translates and they notice that Sogeking is not with them anymore. Elsewhere, Blueno appears before Luffy.

episodes.title: Give Robin Back! Luffy vs. Blueno!
