episodes.summary: As an order comes down to evacuate the island in preparation for bombardment, Navy soldiers rush to their ships. Meanwhile, Vegapunk pleads with Saturn to halt the attack, arguing how vital the island is for the future of humanity, but Saturn refuses to listen.

episodes.title: An Admired Hero - The Warrior of Liberation Who Saves Bonney
episodes.summary: Vegapunk reveals the secret he alone has been keeping regarding the Pacifistas. Meanwhile, Bonney, her back against the wall, hears a familiar rhythm. It's the rhythm that her father taught her along with the legend of the hero he admired.

episodes.title: Reliable Reinforcements! Dorry and Brogy Arrive!
episodes.summary: The Giant Pirate Crew led by Dorry and Brogy arrive at Egghead, which deeply moves Usopp and the others. Zoro keeps fighting Rob Lucci and the Pacifistas continues to torment the Navy while Luffy shows Bonney how to throw a real punch.

episodes.title: Come In, World - Vegapunk's Message
episodes.summary: Caribou begs Augur and Devon to let him meet Blackbeard. An order is given to the Navy vice admirals to kill Jewelry Bonney at all costs in order to take back control over the Pacifistas. Sanji flees with the injured Vegapunk while Luffy holds St. Saturn back.

episodes.title: Vegapunk's Secret Plan - A Tense Worldwide Broadcast
episodes.summary: Suddenly, Vegapunk's broadcast begins and the whole world is taken by surprise. As everyone rushes to set up Video Transponder Snails and screens to watch it, the Five Elders grow concerned and discuss countermeasures.

episodes.title: The Worst Nightmare - The Five Elders Come Together
episodes.summary: Just like when St. Saturn emerged on Egghead, black lightning strikes and pentagrams appear again. The Pacifistas are rendered immobile by an unknown shadow. Meanwhile, as the time for the Straw Hats to evacuate the island is drawing near, the fight between Zoro and Lucci intensifies.

episodes.title: Friends Fight Together! Luffy and the Warriors of Elbaph
episodes.summary: Dorry and Brogy finally reunite with Luffy. However, they are still facing St. Saturn and St. Warcury in their alternate forms. Dorry blows a horn to alert his people to prepare to escape, but St. Warcury unleashes a deafening roar.

episodes.title: An Imminent Threat - Stussy and Edison's Resolve
episodes.summary: Franky and Bonney clash with Navy vice admirals in front of the Elbaph ship. St. Mars tries to find the room from Vegapunk's broadcast. The heavily injured Stussy tells Kaku the reason she chose to stay behind while Edison takes desperate action to help the Straw Hats escape.

episodes.title: A Stunning Conclusion - Vegapunk's Great Prediction
episodes.summary: Vegapunk's broadcast resumes as people in various locations all over the world listen closely. St. Mars rushes to find the Transponder Snail that is the source of the broadcast while the Straw Hats and their allies clash with the other members of the Five Elders.

episodes.title: The Lost History - Joyboy, the First Pirate
episodes.summary: Vegapunk's revelation sends shockwaves around the world. St. Saturn abandons his fight with Nami and the others and rushes to stop the broadcast at all costs. Vegapunk goes on to expose another stunning truth, this time about Joyboy, the first pirate.

episodes.title: The Void Century - A Revelation About a Sinking World
episodes.summary: The severely injured Edison begs Stussy to escape, but she makes a stunning request in exchange. Meanwhile, Vegapunk presents another astonishing disclosure about a past cataclysm and the Ancient Weapons that will fundamentally challenge the beliefs of people everywhere.

episodes.title: Get the Ship Moving! The Iron Giant Activates
episodes.summary: Vegapunk's revelation shocks even Koby and his fellow SWORD members, leading them to discuss what to do next.

episodes.title: Her and Her Father's Dream! Bonney's Free Future
episodes.summary: Luffy finally hops on the Elbaph ship along with Dorry and Brogy, but the Five Elders catch up to them and begin their assault. Aboard the burning ship, Bonney hears a familiar sound and then finds a new strength in her memories of her father.

episodes.title: Her Father and Mother's Legacy! Bonney's Nika Punch
episodes.summary: Zoro and the others who are on the Sunny in the Labophase finally attempt to escape, but at the cost of an unexpected sacrifice. Meanwhile, as Vegapunk concludes his speech, Bonney once again faces St. Saturn, the object of her great hatred.

episodes.title: The Upheaval of an Era! The Color of the Supreme King That Leads Luffy
episodes.summary: Vegapunk's speech raises the spirits of the pirates across the world, infuriating the Navy and the civilians. However, the broadcast is suddenly cut off while Vegapunk is still speaking. Meanwhile, off the coast of Egghead, the Five Elders are about to deliver the Straw Hats and the Giants a deadly strike

episodes.title: The Truth Behind the Secret Plan - Vegapunk Claims Victory
episodes.summary: Two weeks before the battle erupted on Egghead, Vegapunk found out someone stole a portion of the Mother Flame. Along with Pythagoras and Shaka, he launched an investigation and identified the culprit, also learning their shocking motivation. Then, for the future of humanity, he resolved himself to make a bold decision.

episodes.title: The Promised Horizon - Off to the Long-Awaited Elbaph
episodes.summary: York wakes up to see Island Clouds rising, and to her surprise, something is about to be taken away. Meanwhile, at Mary Geoise, the Celestial Dragons realize their food stock is dwindling and become belligerent. Another one of Vegapunk's Satellites, Lilith wakes up and receives astonishing news.

episodes.title: The Long-sought Elbaph! The Big Reunion Banquet!
episodes.summary: After leaving Egghead, the Straw Hats and the Giant Pirate Crew celebrate their reunion with a big banquet.

episodes.title: Nami in a Fix! An Adventure in Block Kingdom
episodes.summary: Nami awakens to find herself in a completely unfamiliar place. Giant creatures attack one after another, driving her into a corner. At that moment, she hears a voice calling her name.

episodes.title: A Quest in the Land of Mystery! The Secret of the Sun God
episodes.summary: Luffy and the others come across a warrior riding a grasshopper.

episodes.title: Destroy the Miniature Garden - Escape Block Kingdom!
episodes.summary: Pursued by the Sun God, the Straw Hats flee across Block Kingdom at full speed. Amidst the chaos, the Sun God's true objective begins to surface. But as they run, another wall blocks their path. Their breakthrough rests on Luffy's fists.

episodes.title: An Encounter on a Snowfield - Loki, the Accursed Prince
episodes.summary: Leaving the Block Kingdom behind, Luffy and the others find themselves facing a vast snowy landscape and a massive suspension bridge. They resolve to move forward, only to be halted by approaching figures and a mysterious roar.

episodes.title: A Dangerous Deal! Loki of the Underworld and Luffy
episodes.summary: Luffy encounters Loki, the Accursed Prince, who offers him a deal. He hints at a connection to Shanks, all while savage beasts crowd around, staring Luffy down. Meanwhile, Zoro and the others on the suspension bridge realize someone is following them.

episodes.title: A Gargantuan Wave of Emotion - The Dreamlike Scenery of Elbaph
episodes.summary: As the Great Erik, carrying Robin and the others, reaches the island of Elbaph, a breathtaking rainbow stretches out before them. Yet even greater astonishment awaits them in the direction the ship is traveling.

episodes.title: I Want You to Praise Me - The Reunion of Robin and Saul
episodes.summary: Robin and the others finally arrive at the port of the Western Village in Elbaph.

episodes.title: Saul's Resolve - The Inherited Will of Ohara
episodes.summary: Robin formally introduces Luffy and the others to Saul. Then his assistant, Ange, shows them around the school, where Usopp is shocked by the education being provided there. Meanwhile, Robin is taken to the library by Saul, where she is met with an incredible sight.

episodes.title: A Welcome with Friends' Cups and Intruders Seeking Loki
episodes.summary: Robin, Chopper, Bonney, and Lilith enjoy the Owl Library.

episodes.title: Encountering Loki - Gunko of the Knights of God
episodes.summary: Amidst the roaring banquet with the Giants, Luffy hears the legend of the Sun God passed down in Elbaph and learns why Loki is being held captive. In the Underworld, two mysterious guests appear before Loki, expressing their desire to recruit him into their order of knights.

episodes.title: Shamrock Appears - Commander of the Knights of God
episodes.summary: Luffy and some of his companions snuck out of the banquet to explore the deceased king's castle.

episodes.title: Ancient History - The Harley Passed Down by Elbaph
episodes.summary: Leaving behind a brutal parting gift, Shamrock and Gunko of the Knights of God abandon Loki and move on to their next strategy. Meanwhile, Franky is shown old wall paintings, and Robin reads an important religious text passed down since ancient times in Elbaph.

episodes.title: The Legend Lurking in Elbaph - The Identity of the Mountain-Eater
episodes.summary: While exploring the abandoned castle, Luffy and the others find a strange mark on the floor of the throne room and hear a mysterious voice out of nowhere. At the banquet, Oimo tells Usopp the tale of a legendary man linked to the Pirate King.

episodes.title: Get the Key! Luffy vs. Scopper Gaban
The Heinous Sinner - Loki of the Underworld Freed?!
episodes.summary: While observing the Jewel Tree Adam along with Ripley, Franky learns of Elbaph's weak points. Meanwhile, in the Underworld, Luffy and Zoro find a heavily injured Loki. As they argue over whether to unchain him, an unexpected turn of events blindsides them.

episodes.title: What I Fear Most
episodes.summary: A massive snake suddenly attacks the Walrus School. Saul and the other teachers stand their ground to protect the children, but just then, another mystery strikes, plunging the school into pure panic.

episodes.title: A Nightmarish Game - The Dark Plot of the Knights of God
episodes.summary: Saul tries to stop the marching children, but as he reaches out to them, some unknown force gets in his way. Meanwhile, hearing the school's emergency call throws Dorry and the others at the Western Village into disarray, just as a monster appears before them as well.

episodes.title: Save the Children! The Elbaph Warriors Rise Up
episodes.summary: As monsters assault villages throughout Elbaph, the Giants scramble to hold them back. Meanwhile, as the sleeping children get closer to the fire, Saul tries everything to stop them, but suddenly, he finds his efforts stymied.

episodes.title: Elbaph in Flames! Jinbe's Shoulder Throw Explodes!
episodes.summary: In the Underworld, Loki talks about a pirate he idolized when he was young. Meanwhile, in the Sun World, the marching children get closer to the fire. The Elbaph Fire Brigade tries to extinguish the flames, while others beg the children to stop. When all hope seems lost, a lone savior arrives to turn the tide.

episodes.title: The Threat of the Arrow-Arrow Fruit - Gunko vs. the Straw Hats
episodes.summary: Gunko from the Knights of God shows up right in front of Nami and the others and reveals to them that their plan is to take the children to Mary Geoise. Enraged, the Straw Hats launch an attack, only to be completely overwhelmed by Gunko's extraordinary power.
